title: Isolate test state
summary: Each Playwright test normally gets a fresh browser context. A context separates saved state such as cookies between tests.
introduction: Each Playwright test normally gets a fresh browser context. A context separates saved state such as cookies between tests. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Each Playwright test normally gets a fresh browser context. A context separates saved state such as cookies between tests.

blocks.title: Isolate test state

blocks.text: This test starts from its own page fixture. Another test should arrange its own required data.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain why test B should not depend on test A having clicked Save.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not rely on test order to create the state a test needs.
For more detail later, use this [Playwright further reading](https://playwright.dev/docs/intro).
